views.title: Russom and its suburbs
views.description: Actual Public World 1. Neighborhoods spread into suitable neighboring hexes along roads, rather than ending in isolated circles.

views.title: Russom — building detail
views.description: Detached houses, terraces, villas and apartments vary in footprint, roof form and height. The layout stays fixed when zooming.

views.title: Eastern cities
views.description: The current world layout with continuous city districts and lower-density outskirts.

views.title: Mountains — previous rendering
views.description: Previous shader and atlas, on the same live-world location and camera as the revised view. The source was stretched to a square, warped and blended with a rotated copy.

views.title: Mountains — revised rendering
views.description: NASA Alps relief in square ground pixels. Unrotated windows of the photograph sit at random offsets, so there is no repeat, stretch, warp or mirroring.

views.title: Mountain ranges of the northeast
views.description: Glacial, temperate and tropical ranges side by side. Character follows the terrain beyond each range's foothills and shifts regionally, with glaciers gathering toward range cores.

views.title: Arid range
views.description: A range whose foothills give onto desert: Hindu Kush relief, brown ridges with snow only on the highest ground.

views.title: Temperate range
views.description: Forest and grassland beyond the foothills: Alpine relief, with patches of glacier where the range is deepest.

views.title: Tropical range
views.description: Jungle beyond the foothills: New Guinea highland relief, densely forested and snow-free, blending into temperate relief across the range.

views.title: Public World 1
views.description: The full current world with the revised terrain and settlements.

views.title: Forest meets desert
views.description: Actual Public World 1 terrain. Each terrain claims ground with its own fractal noise, so the border wanders and interlocks instead of following hex edges.

views.title: Forest meets desert — maximum zoom
views.description: The same border at 24× zoom, rendered at device resolution. NASA Landsat 45 m detail keeps the ground sharp where Blue Marble imagery alone would blur.

views.title: Farmland among forest, plains and grassland
views.description: A demonstration with known farm tiles; the public map hides Public World 1 farm locations. Farmland keeps the colour of the terrain it sits on and takes Kansas field structure from NASA Landsat.

views.title: Farmland — close zoom
views.description: Field boundaries and centre-pivot circles at 16× zoom, in the same palette as the surrounding plains.
